items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: You had Gene Schrader on piano? Yes. And, so, the second night, we had a different band.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, I must tell you about that; you know, we played that big opening night and my God, what a night ---
You had Gene Schrader on piano?
Yes. And, so, the second night, we had a different band. We had a different clarinet player ---
